title: (a) If any requirement of section 172
text:
50. (a) If any requirement of section 172

is not complied with in the case
of any ship; or

(b) if obstruction is caused to the

port health officer in the

discharge of his duty.

154(1) Fine which may extend to
three times the value of the
property not accounted for
or if such value is not
ascertained, to five hundred
rupees, but nothing herein
shall affect his liability
under sub-section (1) of
section 154 to account for
the property not accounted
for.

163(1) Fine which may extend to
one thousand rupees in
respect of each such

seaman.

General Fine which may extend to

five hundred rupees, but
nothing herein shall affect
the claim for compensation
under sub-section
(1) of section 169.

171 Fine which may extend to
one hundred rupees.

172 The owner shall be liable to
fine which may extend to
two hundred rupees unless
he can prove that the noncompliance was not caused
by his inattention, neglect
or wilful default;
The owner or master shall
be liable to fine which may
extend to two hundred
rupees unless he can prove
that the obstruction was
caused without his

knowledge or connivance.
